scripts.test: docker compose exec api npm test
scripts.typecheck: docker compose exec api npx tsc --noEmit && docker compose exec web npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.lint: docker compose exec api npm run lint && docker compose exec web npm run lint
scripts.format: docker compose exec -w /app api npx prettier --write .
scripts.format:check: docker compose exec -w /app api npx prettier --check .
scripts.build: docker compose exec web npm run build
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run format:check && npm run lint
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec api npm run db:migrate --
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec api npm run db:seed
